tools.name: search_orlandu
tools.description: Full-text search over every page, card, glossary term and gallery caption on orlandu.com. Returns the best-matching pages with a snippet and URL. Use it first, then read_orlandu_page for the full text.

tools.name: read_orlandu_page
tools.description: The full readable text of one orlandu.com page as Markdown (no images). Give the page's URL or slug, e.g. 'pvm-20l5-buying-guide' or 'https://www.orlandu.com/pvm-vs-bvm.html'.

tools.name: list_orlandu_pages
tools.description: Every page on orlandu.com with its title, URL and one-line description — the site map for an agent.

tools.name: sony_monitor_specs
tools.description: Specifications of the Sony PVM, BVM and LMD monitors in the collection (display, size, resolution, formats, inputs, option slots, weight, dimensions, era). Optional model filter, e.g. 'PVM-20L5' or 'BVM'. Dataset CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: playchoice_10_library
tools.description: The 52 games Nintendo released for the PlayChoice-10 arcade system, each with a photo of its original game board. Dataset CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: bkm_cards
tools.description: Every Sony BKM option card for the CRT-era BVM and PVM monitors: Sony's name, what it does, which chassis it fits, and the Sony source. Optional filter matched against the card model AND the Fits column, e.g. 'BKM-129X', 'PVM-20L5' or 'BVM-A'. Dataset CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: console_video_out
tools.description: How each retro console in the collection reaches a Sony professional monitor: the modification (if any), the video output used, and the cable chain. Optional console filter, e.g. 'Genesis'. Dataset CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: plan_connection
tools.description: Plan the connection from a retro console to one of the Sony monitors in the collection: the best signal the pair shares, the cable chain step by step, sync and 75-ohm termination rules, and whether a BKM card, a console mod or adapter, or a converter is needed. Consoles: NES, SNES, N64, GameCube, Ge

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sony_monitor_specs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
